reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #58 is a Red Team bounty whose stated deliverable is an attack report: 'Attack methodology', 'Evidence of consensus break (screenshots, logs)', 'Impact assessment', 'Recommended mitigations'. It targets three LIVE external attestation nodes (50.28.86.131, 50.28.86.153, 76.8.228.245:8099) and asks the researcher to 'break' cross-node consensus. It does not request any reproducible defect, feature, or maintenance change inside Scottcjn/rustchain-bounties. This repository contains no 3-node consensus implementation: all consensus/P2P code lives in the separate repository Scottcjn/Rustchain (owner comment 3934602478: 'Fix: PR Scottcjn/Rustchain#301 merged.'). The only in-repo consensus artifacts are historical submissions for a DIFFERENT issue (bounties/issue-2418-attestation-replay-cross-node/) that are patches against the Rustchain node repo, not this one. The bounty is already fulfilled/competed: the owner paid 30 RTC to @liu971227-sys (comment 3934602478) and 200 RTC to @allornothingai (comment 4064710904), and other claimants already filed competing reports/PRs against Scottcjn/Rustchain (maelrx PRs Scottcjn/Rustchain#4218 and #4657 on 2026-05-10/11; bat123121567890-cmd submission 2026-07-06; fresh claims by byctrl/calproencrip/jairojr32-svg on 2026-10-29). No open PR in Scottcjn/rustchain-bounties references issue #58 (GitHub search type:pr state:open returned total_count=0). Per the classification rule (documentation deliverable / already-competed and disbursed bounty), this must not be converted into a fallback code change or PR. Checkout left unchanged at upstream main.
